THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

FIRST PANELLAST PANEL
THE SCENE

Your theatre class drew an old play in four pictures. The pictures are called panels. In the play, a servant helps two young people in love trick his boss. Tonight the four panels go on the wall by the stage. You do not have them yet. Four people each can help you get one.

THE HISTORY

Your panels retell a kind of play from Italy. Actors played it in town squares 450 years ago. They wore masks and made up their own words. The most famous servant was Arlecchino.
